# Check Venmo account existence by searching users using email

def venmo_exact_user_exists(email):
    exact_matches=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        res = apis.venmo.search_users(access_token=venmo_token, query=email, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not res:
            break
        # exact match on email field
        exact = [u for u in res if (u.get('email','').lower().strip()==email.lower().strip())]
        exact_matches.extend(exact)
        # If returned less than page_limit, likely last page
        if len(res) < page_limit:
            # still might be more but we assume no; safe enough
            break
        page_index += 1
    return exact_matches

# Venmo exact matches by email across all pages

def venmo_exact_matches(email):
    matches=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        res = apis.venmo.search_users(access_token=venmo_token, query=email, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not res:
            break
        exact=[u for u in res if (u.get('email','') or '').lower().strip()==email.lower().strip()]
        matches.extend(exact)
        page_index += 1
    return matches
